Conclusion¶

The BMW Predictive Maintenance System builds a complete vehicle-risk workflow: Python validates source data, PySpark transforms and scores records, Amazon S3 stores curated outputs, Athena supports SQL analysis, and QuickSight presents the results. Terraform provisions the supporting AWS infrastructure.

The solution processed 210 vehicles and turns mileage, faults, maintenance frequency, temperature trends, and regional data into actionable maintenance priorities. It provides a concise foundation for proactive fleet planning and data-driven service decisions.
